title: Medroxyprogesterone Acetate Plus Atorvastatin in Young Women With Early Endometrial Carcinoma and Atypical Endometrial Hyperplasia

sections.abstract: To explore the treatment efficacy of medroxyprogesterone acetate plus atorvastatin in patients with atypical endometrial hyperplasia (AEH) and early endometrial carcinoma (EEC) for conservative treatment.
